# Bundled ProPainter code

Copied from https://github.com/sczhou/ProPainter at commit `3267825`
(`inference_propainter.py`, `core/`, `model/`, `RAFT/`, `utils/`).

One file is modified: `inference_propainter.py` gains a `--weights_dir`
argument so checkpoints can be loaded from any folder (marked at the top of
the file). Nothing else is changed.
